query: Which independent external dataset and prospective pilot design will align evaluation metrics with clinical endpoints and regulatory expectations, and what audit-trail/document formats are required for submission?

response.query: Which independent external dataset and prospective pilot design will align evaluation metrics with clinical endpoints and regulatory expectations, and what audit-trail/document formats are required for submission?
response.answer: Use the National Health Information Benchmarking Consortium (NHIBC) dataset for evaluation; a prospective pilot design with adaptive elements is ideal. Required audit-trail/document formats include CSV and PDF submissions.
